articles.title: Today’s word of the day September 30: Cogitate meaning, pronunciation, origin and examples explained
articles.description: Word of the Day: Cogitate means to think deeply and carefully about a question, idea or decision. Used mainly as a verb, the word suggests deliberate and prolonged reflection rather than a passing thought. Originating from the Latin “cogitare”, meaning “to think” or “to consider”, cogitate is often found in formal, literary and academic writing where careful reasoning is being described.

articles.title: Should You Continue Your SIP When Markets Fall? | 3 Reasons to Stay Invested
articles.description: Should you continue your equity SIP when the stock market is falling? In this episode of MC Explains, we break down three reasons why continuing your equity SIP during a market correction can be important for long-term investors. Remember, continuing an SIP does not guarantee returns. Equity investments carry market risk and are generally intended for investors with an appropriate long-term investment horizon. Investors should also review their mutual funds on their individual merits and invest according to their financial goals and risk profile. This video is part of MC Explains, an investor education initiative brought to you by Moneycontrol.com and Invesco Mutual Fund.
